text_block_list.text: One day, I came to observe a Winning Live.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Kgh... Isn't there some truly EXCELLENT 
way to break through this situation...?!
choice_data_list: Are you here to watch too?
Are you here to observe too?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Ah, indeed. In preparation for the 
upcoming Winning Live, of course.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
For an Umamusume, the live stage is a 
place to shine. However...! There is one 
massive problem!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To perform only a single song! My 
overflowing charm won't be fully showcased 
at this rate...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If only, ahhh...!! If only we sped up the 
tempo, could we not squeeze in more 
songs...?!
choice_data_list:
Maybe giving it your all in limited time 
would be……

Thinking outside the box is really 
important.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Giving it everything in the limited time 
we have...? Ahâthat's it!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You mean to say we should spend dense, 
meaningful time together rather than 
dragging things out... is that it?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! I see, I see! Indeed, you do 
have a point there!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's just one song, I can put on a 
more intense performance than anyone! 
—Because I'm me!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let's see it through to 
completion! My one-and-only, unrivaled 
concert!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! Isn't that right? Of course it 
is!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Someday, I shall become the 'Century's End 
Conqueror' and illuminate the entire 
world!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And that is why, like the sun blazing in 
the heavens, I shall never be bound by 
anything!
